data.rationale: The proposed workflow has the right goal and the right order: Find a Park by State, then the state, then a park or section link. But it only parameterizes state, leaves out park and section, and makes the final click vague ("a park, heritage area, or Basic Information link"), so an automation couldn't tell which link to click.
